answers.title: Is it safe to have sex while pregnant?
answers.comment:
When you’re carrying such precious cargo, it’s understandable to be wary about things.

Check with your doctor first, but the good news is: pregnancy sex is generally a safe, pleasurable way of de-stressing and bonding with your partner until the end of your last trimester.

answers.title: How can I improve my body image and feel sexy?
answers.comment:
It’s OK to not be feeling the “Pregnancy Glow”. Many Flo members talk about losing confidence in bed for lots of reasons.

Check out articles and chat with the Flo community for tips on how to embrace your pregnant body and feel sexy and powerful.

answers.title: Are there bump-friendly sex positions?
answers.comment:
Yes! As a general rule, as long as you’re comfortable and not putting pressure on your belly, all positions are OK.

But if you’re looking to spice things up in a safe way, you can check out Flo’s sex therapists’ suggestions like “The Propped-up Doggy” or “The Hot Seat”.

answers.title: Are sex toys safe while pregnant?
answers.comment:
As long as your doctor hasn’t advised against it, there’s no need to put your pleasure on hold!

Our sex experts have tips on pregnancy-safe sex toys, what to use if your sensitivity has changed, and tips on both solo and partnered play.
